title: SET_OPTIONS fails with SET_OPTIONS_TOO_MANY_SIGNERS
pattern: A transaction whose SET_OPTIONS operation fails at apply is still written into the closed ledger: its fee is charged, its sequence number is consumed, and nothing it did is kept. The result carries the operation's code (too_many_signers). A 21st signer; an account holds at most 20.

hazards.placement: AccountEntry.signers at its maximum of 20, and one past it

facts.says: No operation changed state: the operation meta is empty.
The fee is still charged: the fee source changes in fee processing.
